key_insight: A tool-augmented LLM pipeline can make medical calculations from patient notes more reliable by separating variable extraction from deterministic rule execution.
clinical_relevance: This approach may improve the accuracy and consistency of calculator-based outputs used in clinical decision support and documentation workflows.
method: Generate reusable executable tools for each calculator.
Use a constrained extractor to map patient notes into calculator-ready inputs before deterministic calculation.
evidence_signal: On MedCalc-Bench, the method reached 86.73% final-answer accuracy, outperforming one-shot prompting and supervised fine-tuning-only baselines by 24.0 and 17.27 percentage points.
watch_item: Residual errors still occur in clinical-semantic extraction and benchmark-specific output formatting, so real-world deployment would need careful validation.
paper_title: Tool-Augmented Large Language Models for Reliable Medical Calculation from Patient Notes
